Enum Class Category

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Category>
foodreview.Category
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Category>, Constable
public enum Category extends Enum<Category>
Creates an enumerable datatype of food groups to be used to categorize reviews within the Food Review System application.

This enum is used by Review objects and both the DatabaseHandler/ReviewSystem to act as a data filter for reviews and average calculation.
